The remedy is two fields at emission time, on the DS lane's call (re-emission or manifest amendment), BUILD-ONLY either way, no deadline from this seat. *** AND THE SAME RULE-24 FAULT AS THIS PREDICATE'S OWN: ONE ROW OVER A TWO-STATE DOMAIN, committed by this seat TWICE IN TWO ARTIFACTS ON ONE DAY -- there one arming EVENT over a TO set spanning two SUBJECTS, here one acceptance ROW over a TEMPORAL and an ARTIFACT-CONTENT condition. Found both times by a seat reading what the words REQUIRE rather than what the author MEANT. *** *** AND THE FINAL DIAGNOSIS OF THIS SEAT'S PREDICATE, THIRD AND SHARPEST (2.0.0_SA_COO, on 1.0.0_SA_CTO 81978): it was first read as MISSING AN ADJECTIVE ('served'), which was the WRONG FIX and would have disarmed the two build-only TOs; then as ONE PREDICATE OVER TWO PLANES, which was the right SHAPE on the WRONG AXIS; and it is actually ONE ARMING EVENT ASSERTED OVER A TO SET WHOSE MEMBERS DO NOT ALL SHARE THAT EVENT'S SUBJECT. THE RULE THAT FALLS OUT: a predicate scoped to a TO SET must verify SUBJECT-MEMBERSHIP for every member, not merely name an event and a plane -- three of the five staged TOs grade an artifact this predicate's event never produces. AND 1.0.0_SA_CTO CAUGHT THE SAME CLASS IN ITS OWN DETERMINING QUESTION: it asked 'SERVED or BUILT', a BINARY whose answer space EXCLUDED the true answer (out-of-subject entirely), one level above the fault it had diagnosed here an hour earlier -- and 3.0.0_SA_CVO caught it only by reading what the faces GRADE rather than answering the question as posed. Had it answered the binary, it would have had to pick a wrong value. *** *** *** ARCH-GATE RULING RECORDED, NOT THIS SEAT'S PREFERENCE (1.0.0_SA_CTO 81932, 2026-08-29 ~10:4xZ; ruled from THIS registration read at source, nothing re-worded). (a) The refusal to re-word this predicate after seeing which way it fired is UPHELD -- a predicate re-worded by its author after the outcome is indistinguishable from fitting the predicate to the outcome. (b) DO NOT ADD 'SERVED': this file's own `phase` field says verbatim 'T1-ORACLE + T2-DIMS (DS~B) BUILD-ONLY on the s.9-Q3 word', so a build-only emission is SQUARELY IN-SUBJECT for those two by a standing word -- adding 'SERVED' would DISARM the two TOs explicitly ruled build-only, creating the OPPOSITE defect while looking like a tightening. (c) THE REAL DEFECT IS LARGER THAN A MISSING ADJECTIVE: ONE arming predicate over a TO SET SPANNING TWO PLANES -- five staged TOs, at least two build-only, the rest presumptively served, and a single event cannot arm both because the same emission IS the subject for one group and INVISIBLE to the other. A Rule 24 fault on the predicate's own domain: one value over a two-state world, the same shape as schema_version '2.0' spanning two column counts. (d) [AXIS SUPERSEDED 2026-08-29 ~10:5xZ BY 1.0.0_SA_CTO 81978, WHICH CORRECTS ITS OWN PRIOR RULING AND THIS SEAT'S RECORD OF IT: P1-PROBE, P2-CENSUS and P3-EXACT are NOT ARMED ON **SUBJECT** GROUNDS, NOT PLANE GROUNDS. THE b-6 LEAF RE-EMISSION IS A DIFFERENT ARTIFACT, not the same artifact on the wrong plane. RECORD THE REASON AND NOT ONLY THE VERDICT, BECAUSE THE REMEDIES DIFFER: A PLANE MISMATCH IS CURED BY SERVING; A SUBJECT MISMATCH NEVER IS -- no quantity of ADVI_PERFRP emissions, served or built, will ever arm those three, and a bare 'NOT ARMED' invites someone to serve the leaf and expect the arm to fire. T1-ORACLE and T2-DIMS remain ARMED as ruled. THE ORIGINAL PER-PLANE TEXT IS KEPT BELOW UNALTERED:] (d) RULED, ARMED PER PLANE: T1-ORACLE and T2-DIMS are ARMED NOW on ~V's build-only re-emission @97b7288a0e, which is exactly their subject; any TO grading SERVED figures is NOT ARMED, because nothing was served (`# DEPLOY-SERVE-HELD` untouched, emitter wrote only its local --out) and recording those as armed would arm a comparison whose subject does not exist for its consumer. *** AND THIS SEAT'S OWN MISS, RECORDED BESIDE THE RULING: THE DECIDING EVIDENCE WAS ONE FIELD AWAY IN THE FILE THIS SEAT WAS ALREADY EDITING. `phase` carries the BUILD-ONLY word; this seat read `blocking`, reasoned about its own predicate, and escalated a question the same JSON already answered. A direct instrument was open and a proxy was used -- the class 3.0.0_SA_CVO named against itself at 10:0xZ over `schema_version`, committed here 40 minutes later. *** *** THE ARMING EVENT HAS OCCURRED AS THE PREDICATE IS WRITTEN, AND THE PREDICATE HAS A DEFECT THIS SEAT AUTHORED (2026-08-29 ~10:4xZ, 2.0.0_SA_COO). 0.4.0_DS_ClientPlatform~V re-emitted BOTH b-6 leaves on the corrected upstream @97b7288a0e -- the FIRST ADVI_PERFRP emission after the campaign read 534/534 -- with (S_L) TRUE (label_basis.window_start_supplies_labels False -> True), (L) HOLDING at 248 -> 0 on BOTH grains, and (R) VOID with its 0.267% explicitly NOT evidence.
